Four leading quantum technology companies have joined ABQ‑Net, marking the launch of the United States’ first open‑access quantum communication network. The partnership provides shared access to high‑speed quantum links, enabling accelerated research and development across academia, industry, and government sectors. ABQ‑Net is positioned as a foundational platform for deploying quantum applications at national scale.
